verdict.rationale: Cerebras explicitly documents that existing OpenAI-based applications can switch to Cerebras by changing only the API key, base URL, and model ID, i.e. no provider-specific code changes are needed (cerebras-docs-3, cerebras-docs-4, cerebras-docs-23). However, community reports mention real friction with this compatibility in practice — a hands-on API-format error ('wrong_api_format' on messages.content) and reports that third-party integrations (e.g., Cursor/OpenRouter) were 'patchy at best' before official support existed — showing the swap isn't always as frictionless as advertised. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of a clean mid-workflow provider swap, and no evidence addressing edge cases like multimodal/tool-calling parity issues during a live switch.
